decisions.briefing: It was a strong risk-on day, with the NASDAQ up 2.6% and the S&P 500 up 2.3%, so our playbook says to put idle cash to work instead of waiting. Cash is $445.88, a little under the usual $500 buy threshold, so we sent one modest buy for FPS, the cleanest four-signal setup; if the order is too small to fill, the cash stays put. All seven current positions are held, and their automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules stay in place.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.6% and the S&P 500 up 2.3%, which shows buyers were confident across the market. Large tech and chip names led, with AMD, AMZN, ALAB and MPWR all showing fresh bullish MACD crossovers, while NVDA lagged and stayed in a downtrend, so the rally did not lift every big name. No news headlines were included in today's data, so this summary is based only on price and momentum readings, not on a specific news trigger.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面走高，納指升2.6%，標普500升2.3%，反映資金風險胃納明顯回升。科技及半導體板塊領漲，AMD、亞馬遜、ALAB及MPWR等均出現MACD黃金交叉，惟輝達仍處跌勢，可見升市並非雨露均霑。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，以上分析僅根據價格及動能指標，未能指明具體的新聞催化因素。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, which pushes the major indexes up together. Today both the NASDAQ and the S&P 500 rose more than 2%, which is a clear risk-on signal. Disciplined traders often keep some cash on quiet days and use it on days like this, when the market's momentum is working in their favor.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On）市況，是指投資者信心充足，資金湧向增長股、科技股等高風險資產，帶動主要指數齊齊上揚。今日納指與標普500同時升逾2%，是典型的風險偏好訊號。有紀律的投資者往往在淡靜日子保留現金，待這類大市動能配合的日子才出手部署。
